local chosen = "Animation1"

function play_anim(model)
	local controller = model:WaitForChild("AnimationController")
	local animation = script:WaitForChild(chosen)
	
	local animtrack = controller:LoadAnimation(animation)
	--animtrack:Stop()
	animtrack:Play()

end

play_anim(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Normal"))
play_anim(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Super"))
